fit._why: Orbit fit is a multiplier on science. These cut-offs only choose the word shown to the player.

text.title: Mission plan
text.orbitStep: 2. Which orbit will you go into?
text.orbitHelp: An orbit is the path your spacecraft takes round {target}. Lower orbits see more detail but need a bigger braking burn, which means more fuel.
text.changesScience: 🔬 The goal decides which instruments score the most science points.
text.changesFuel: ⛽ The orbit decides how hard you must brake at {target}, so how much fuel you carry. A good match between goal and orbit scores extra points.

orbits.name: Low circle
orbits.short: Very close to the ground. Sharp pictures of every spot.

orbits.name: Long oval
orbits.short: Dips close, then swings far away. Needs half the braking.

objectives.name: Map the Moon
objectives.short: Take pictures of the whole Moon.

objectives.name: Hunt for water ice
objectives.short: Find ice hiding in dark craters at the poles.

objectives.name: Study the Moon's magnetism
objectives.short: Measure the old magnetic patches in the rocks.

orbits.name: Long oval
orbits.short: Cheap to get into. Far away most of the time, so it sees the whole planet.

orbits.name: Low circle
orbits.short: Close and sharp, but needs more than twice the braking.

objectives.name: Send back photos of Mars
objectives.short: Reach Mars orbit and take pictures.

objectives.name: Watch the dust storms
objectives.short: Follow Mars weather across the whole planet.

objectives.name: Look for buried water
objectives.short: Find ice and old rivers under the dust.

orbits.name: Close dives
orbits.size: 4,200 km above the clouds, then far out
orbits.short: Skims over the clouds every 53 days. Diving deep makes the burn small.

orbits.name: Wide loops
orbits.size: 214,000 km up, then very far out
orbits.short: Stays far from the clouds and passes near the big moons.

objectives.name: Study clouds and magnetism
objectives.short: Look at Jupiter's storms and its huge magnetic field.

objectives.name: Explore the icy moons
objectives.short: Look for the hidden oceans under Europa's ice.
